'''''Erica maderensis''''' is a plant belonging to the genus ''[[Erica (plant)|Erica]]''. The species is endemic to [[Madeira]].<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:329069-1 Plants of the World Online</ref>
